en: The human jaw acts as a third-class lever when biting an apple, meaning your jaw muscles must pull much harder than the apple resists.
A banana peel is extremely slippery because it contains microscopic gel-filled follicles that burst into a slick layer when stepped on.
The Moon's gravity is about one-sixth of Earth's, meaning a 60-pound child would weigh only 10 pounds on the lunar surface.
Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole because the north end of a compass needle is attracted to it.
A single bolt of lightning is five times hotter than the surface of the Sun, reaching temperatures of about 30,000 Kelvin.
A standard mirror reverses light left-to-right rather than front-to-back, which is why your reflection raises its left hand when you raise your right.
Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air because liquid water molecules are packed much more tightly together.
Under certain specific conditions, hot water can actually freeze faster than cold water, a surprising phenomenon known as the Mpemba effect.
A drawn bow stores elastic potential energy in its bent limbs, which instantly transfers to the arrow as kinetic energy upon release.
Astronauts on the International Space Station float not because there is zero gravity, but because they are continuously falling around the Earth.
Ocean waves carry mechanical energy across vast distances without actually moving the water forward, as the water particles only move in circles.
You can generate static electricity strong enough to make your hair stand up just by rubbing a balloon to transfer electrons.
